packageRules.description: Compose — every androidx.compose.* artifact is pinned by the BOM (versions.composeBom in gradle/libs.versions.toml); the member libraries carry no version of their own.
Hilt/Dagger — the Gradle plugin, hilt-android and hilt-android-compiler all resolve from versions.hilt and MUST land in one PR; a split version fails the build.
androidx.hilt (hilt-navigation-compose, hilt-work, hilt-compiler) — versions.androidxHilt, released independently of Dagger/Hilt above.

Kotlin + KSP — the Compose compiler plugin ships in the Kotlin release; KSP is no longer Kotlin-derived (since 2.3.0) but must be re-checked on every Kotlin bump, and KSP sets the AGP floor (see the comments in gradle/libs.versions.toml), so they land as one PR. Patterns deliberately require ':' or '.' after 'kotlin' so org.jetbrains.kotlinx (coroutines) does NOT fall in here.

KSP ceiling: KSP 2.3.12+ refuses AGP < 8.12 (MINIMUM_SUPPORTED_AGP_VERSION) and 2.3.13 has a concurrency regression (google/ksp#3286); we are on AGP 8.10. Lift this together with an AGP bump — see the comments in gradle/libs.versions.toml.
Dagger/Hilt ceiling: the Hilt Gradle plugin 2.59+ requires AGP 9 (and Gradle 9.1+). Lift this together with the AGP 9 migration — see the comments in gradle/libs.versions.toml.

R8 override (versions.r8): AGP 8.10 bundles an R8 that cannot read Kotlin 2.4 metadata, so the root buildscript puts R8 9.1 ahead of it. Held to the 9.1 line Google lists for Kotlin 2.4; a newer line, or dropping the override, comes with an AGP bump.
Room — runtime, ktx, compiler and testing all resolve from versions.room.
Lifecycle — viewmodel-compose and runtime-compose resolve from versions.lifecycle.
CameraX — camera2, lifecycle and view resolve from versions.camerax.
Coroutines — kotlinx-coroutines-android and -test resolve from versions.coroutines.
Android Gradle Plugin — application and library plugins resolve from versions.agp.
